visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing black tactical-style gloves stands in a kitchen, holding a salt grinder over a large, thick piece of highly marbled raw Wagyu beef resting on a silver metal tray. They vigorously grind salt over the meat's surface. (2) The steak is placed into a hot, square stainless steel pan on a gas stove. White steam and grease bubbles erupt as the meat sears. A metal fork and tongs are used to flip the meat, showing a dark brown, crispy caramelized exterior. (3) The steak is moved to a dark wooden cutting board to rest. In the residual heat of the pan, a block of yellow butter is melted, and a large quantity of peeled white garlic cloves are added and stirred until they reach a deep golden brown color. (4) A man with short black hair and a black t-shirt sits at a wooden dining table. He uses a knife and fork to slice a piece of the steak, revealing a vibrant pink, medium-rare interior. He places a fried garlic clove on top of a meat slice and eats it with an expression of deep pleasure and a subsequent thumbs-up.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 蒜香和牛. (2) [Subtitle]: 退冰到完全軟. (3) [Subtitle]: 玫瑰鹽抹滿. (4) [Subtitle]: 熱鍋到滴水不沾. (5) [Subtitle]: 下一點油不要太多. (6) [Subtitle]: 和牛油多會出很多油. (7) [Subtitle]: 大火大約煎三分鐘到表皮焦香. (8) [Subtitle]: 起鍋靜置四分鐘. (9) [Subtitle]: 小火下奶油. (10) [Subtitle]: 下大蒜. (11) [Subtitle]: 煎到焦黃起鍋. (12) [Subtitle]: 牛排再回鍋煎30秒. (13) [Subtitle]: 和牛完成!. (14) [Subtitle]: 和牛很油，容易膩. (15) [Subtitle]: 這樣份量做好四人吃. (16) [Subtitle]: 或者搭配飯. (17) [Subtitle]: 啤酒.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A domestic kitchen with white tiled walls, a stainless steel gas stove, and various bottles of cooking oil and seasonings. Later, a wooden dining table in a brightly lit room.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with the rhythmic, mechanical clicking of a salt grinder and a gentle acoustic guitar melody. The male narrator introduces the steak in a friendly tone. (2) A loud, sharp 'click' as the gas stove ignites, followed immediately by an intense, continuous broadband sizzling sound as meat hits the pan. The narrator's speech rate is steady, providing instruction over the high-frequency sizzle. (3) The sizzling softens to a low-frequency bubble as butter melts. The sound of garlic cloves cascading into the pan creates a series of short, percussive thuds. (4) The final phase features the distinct, crisp scraping sound of a knife cutting through a seared crust on a wooden board, followed by quiet chewing and an enthusiastic vocal sigh of satisfaction from the speaker.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a step-by-step instructional guide on how to prepare a high-quality Wagyu steak with garlic butter, emphasizing technical cooking tips such as heat control and resting time, ultimately showcasing the delicious result to entice the audience.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The high marbling of the meat and the detailed focus on searing techniques suggest a gourmet or lifestyle cooking focus.
